findings.reason: the deliverable must name the process that holds the lock (a helper or child distinct from the tick), or the node writes a fixture whose fourth case cannot stay live and whose gate fails.
findings.text: §39's deliverable says the fixture's registrations are "written as files for the liveness test to read, not held by the test process itself", but liveness is judged by a held advisory lock (`registered = lock_held`, reckon/crew/follower_registration.py:648), so a registration written as a file with no process holding its lock reads `live: False`; the fixture's fourth case asserts the attended registration really reads live (tests/test_the_watcher_sweeps_unfollowed_sessions.py:363-364) and §37's third control turns on the same fact ("with the live-registration test made false, the attended session is swept"), so a file-only registration would sweep the attended session and the field could not pass.

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the test file, `_sweeping_session` (reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:1000, read at reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:396) and both cited modules resolve, and §37's review score of 102 matches the landing comment.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — the done-when names a declared negative control (dropping the session from the watcher's sweep call) and a measurable assertion, and that control can fail.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the control log lands under the run directory, a durable path, with the offered run ids.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, stage names or ticket numbers reach code; the only identifiers are the fixture run ids r-late-review and r-attended-review.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the deliverable's mechanism for marking a session followed, "written as files for the liveness test to read, not held by the test process itself", cannot keep the attended session's registration live, and the fixture's fourth case depends on it reading live.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §39 carries one deliverable: the sweep test drives the tick from a process holding no follower registration.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §39 declares no depends-on/informs/gates edge and needs none: §37, whose test file it edits, is done, and its dispatch route f-tmstwiw-039 resolves to §39.
